content.introduction: The 12-month percentage change in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) for selected categories in August 2026, not seasonally adjusted, shows the following: All items increased by 3.4%, food by 2.7%, food at home by 2.2%, cereals and bakery products by 2.6%, meats, poultry, fish, and eggs by 1.1%, dairy and related products by -0.3%, fruits and vegetables by 3.2%, nonalcoholic beverages and beverage materials by 3.7%, and food away from home by 3.4%. The sources do not provide information on other categories.

| Food away from home | 3.4% | [...] # CPI Home

The Consumer Price Index (CPI) is a measure of the average change over time in the prices paid by urban consumers for a market basket of consumer goods and services. Indexes are available for the U.S. and various geographic areas. Average price data for select utility, automotive fuel, and food items are also available.

## Charts

### 12-month percentage change, Consumer Price Index, selected categories, August 2026, not seasonally adjusted [...] In August, the Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers rose 0.4 percent, seasonally adjusted (SA), and rose 3.4 percent over the last 12 months, not seasonally adjusted (NSA). The index for all items less food and energy rose 0.3 percent in August (SA), up 2.4 percent over the year (NSA).
